verdict.rationale: ADK's GitHub README documents a first-party Tool Confirmation (HITL) flow that guards tool execution with explicit confirmation and custom input, so the product itself directly supports approval before tool calls. Human-in-the-loop also appears in the Workflow Runtime and Task API. However, the evidence is only a README one-liner. It does not show how approval is scoped to specific sensitive tools, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: documentation that confirmation can be configured per specific sensitive tool, in-depth first-party docs on the approval flow (approver experience, deny/timeout handling), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can require human approval before specific sensitive tool calls execute
